note: The model-tier mapping AGENTS.md "Model Tiers" states, as data a gate and a hook can read. A rule, a Skill, or a brief names a tier, never a model, so a model release is an edit to a `models` value here and to the AGENTS.md table, which spec/validate.py holds equal. Each value is the alias that tool's own subagent dispatch accepts, an alias that already tracks the latest model of its family. A dispatch on a tool with no entry, or on one with no way to name a model per subagent, names no model. The model-tier-guard hook in host-setup/agent-safety/claude/ refuses a dispatch at the maintainerOnly tier's model unless the maintainer allowed it at launch.
